name: Romancing the Kingdom
source:
Romancing the Kingdom is the story of Polly, the heir apparent to the throne in the fictional, Arthurian land of Tropia. She has to prove she’s worth of ascension by doing a few tasks, the principle one of convincing a man she’s worthy of bearing his child. Of course, she can always take what she wants by force…but, it’s considered in this mythical culture better to have the man come willingly.

Throughout the game, you'll make choices as the main character, Polly, as well as experience some scenes from other characters points of view. The current public version of the game, .40, has content through day 15 in game.
translation:
《浪漫王国》讲述波莉的故事。她是虚构的亚瑟王传说之地特罗皮亚的王位继承人。她必须完成几项任务，证明自己配得上继承王位，其中最主要的是说服一名男子，让他相信自己值得为其生下孩子。当然，她也可以用武力得到想要的一切……但在这个神秘文化中，让男人心甘情愿地服从被认为更好。

游戏中，你会以主人公波莉的身份作出选择，也会从其他角色的视角体验部分场景。目前公开版本为0.40，内容截至游戏内第15天。
